hypotheses.C0_feature_coverage: At least 25 competent predeclared labels enter the causal audit.
hypotheses.C1_frozen_coalitions_transfer: The frozen 64-channel coalition moves its semantic score positively on at least 65 percent of held-out donor-recipient pairs in every source layer.
hypotheses.C2_frozen_coalitions_beat_random_channel: The 64-channel coalition has a larger mean semantic shift than matched random channels in every source layer.
hypotheses.C3_feature_specific_channels_matter: The correct 64-channel coalition has a larger mean semantic shift than a wrong-feature coalition in every source layer.
hypotheses.C4_effect_is_semantically_specific: For the correct 64-channel coalition, mean semantic shift exceeds mean absolute Gram-matched-null shift in every source layer.
hypotheses.C5_layer3_is_not_less_causal: Layer 3's 64-channel directional fraction is no lower than Layer 1's.
